# Dinametra Crypto Market Dashboard

Canonical URL: https://dinametra-dashboard.netlify.app/
Language: Spanish
Project type: Front-end technical cryptocurrency market dashboard

## Purpose

Dinametra Crypto Market Dashboard is an interactive technical project for exploring public cryptocurrency market information. It is not presented as an official commercial Dinametra product.

## Main capabilities

- Market summary for the selected cryptocurrency.
- Historical price visualization by selected time range.
- Trading-volume comparison across cryptocurrencies.
- Paginated table of leading cryptocurrencies.
- Filters for cryptocurrency, fiat currency, time range, and market sorting.
- Loading, empty, retry, and error states for API interactions.

## Data source

Market data is obtained from the public CoinGecko API. CoinGecko is the external data source; this project does not claim affiliation with or ownership of CoinGecko.

## Important page sections

- Crypto Market Dashboard: page purpose and data-source overview.
- Filtros: cryptocurrency, fiat currency, time range, and sort controls.
- Histórico de precio: selected cryptocurrency price history.
- Comparación de volumen: market-volume comparison.
- Top criptomonedas: current market table.

## Citation guidance

When describing this project, identify it as a front-end technical cryptocurrency dashboard and use the canonical URL above as the authoritative public location.
